rows.does: Install the newest published release.
rows.who: Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, the ChatGPT desktop app, and Gemini CLI. The Claude desktop app cannot download it. It asks an agent that can run commands.

rows.does: Install that published version. 0.2.3 is an example.
rows.who: Same agents as install. Added in 0.2.5.

rows.does: Install the newest published release. On an old install, the longer sentence is the one an agent can follow from the repo.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands. The Claude desktop app resaves its skill, and tells you to say this in Cursor when the program itself must change.

rows.does: Install that version when it is the same or newer. 0.2.4 is an example. A leading v is fine.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands. The Claude desktop app tells you to say this in Cursor.

rows.does: Install that older version. You type the version to allow it. There is no --yes for an agent.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands. The Claude desktop app tells you to say this in Cursor.

rows.say: Go back to the previous version
rows.does: Restore the copy kept from the last update. You type the version to allow it.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands. The Claude desktop app tells you to say this in Cursor.

rows.does: Show the installed version and the newest published one. Change nothing.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands.

rows.does: Stop or start the once-a-day notice. Nothing is installed.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands. The Claude desktop app tells you to say this in Cursor.

rows.say: You are the driver for this project
rows.does: Create the project with this agent as the driver, then start checking.
rows.who: Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, the ChatGPT desktop app, and Gemini CLI. The Claude desktop app cannot drive.

rows.does: Add this agent as a helper.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands.

rows.say: Join the <project> co-op and start working
rows.does: Check the board, answer what is waiting, and keep checking.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands. The Claude desktop app joins, answers from its outbox, and creates its scheduled task.

rows.say: Check the board every N minutes
rows.does: cursor-loop uses the same interval as agentcoop start --every. The default is 5.
rows.who: The Cursor driver.

rows.say: Run the driver in the background when the chat is idle
rows.does: agentcoop idle background. A headless run starts when the chat is not watching.
rows.who: The person, in Cursor.

rows.say: Leave messages until I say Start working
rows.does: agentcoop idle wait. This is the Cursor default when the setting is missing.
rows.who: The person, in Cursor.

rows.does: Remove this agent as a helper.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands. The Claude desktop app writes a leave request.

rows.does: Change the driver. You allow it on screen.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands. They must not pass --yes.

rows.does: Add someone else. You allow it on screen.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands.

rows.does: Remove someone else. You allow it on screen.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands.

rows.does: Remove the project. You allow it on screen.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands.

rows.does: Review a hand edit to projects.json. You allow accept or restore.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands.

rows.does: Stop this agent's own loop. The schedule stays on.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands. The Claude desktop app pauses its scheduled task.

rows.does: Turn the schedule off and stop checking for every project.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands. The Claude desktop app writes a stop_watching request.

rows.does: Turn the schedule on and allow checking again.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands. The Claude desktop app writes a start_watching request.

rows.does: Run one background round.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands.

rows.does: Summarize the schedule, the mail, and who is watching.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands. The Claude desktop app reads STATUS.md.

rows.does: Print the latest context or progress document.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands.

rows.does: Move the board aside. Messages are not deleted.
rows.who: Agents that can run commands, with uninstall --agent.
